claim: The implementation declares 100 unique configuration keys: 72 active, 20 conditional and eight no-effect.
Fifteen declaration defaults differ from the Formal Model.
The implemented life cycle is egg, larva, prepupa, pupa, adult in cocoon and adult female.
Males are removed at emergence and do not become free-living agents.
The mechanistic parasitoid subsystem is disabled by default and is not operationally reliable.
Life-stage classes form an ontogenetic inheritance chain.
Stage transitions construct a successor and redirect the nest-cell pointer.
Nest densities are multiplied by 0.001 before capacity is created.
The 1 km female-density grid is cleared but not populated.
The model uses daily steps, with hourly weather determining flyable hours.
Seasonal flags updated in DoLast are available to individuals on the following day.
Dispersal direction is a uniform integer from 0 to 7.
secondary_evidence: Step 1 author confirmation and Doxygen page

claim: The adult age counter is state-dependent rather than a calendar-day counter.
Egg, larva and pupa use linear degree-day accumulation above stage thresholds.
Prepupal development uses a normalised quadratic response and an individual target within ±10%.
Emergence combines overwintering degree-days, a discrete draw and random aspect delay of 0–35 days.
Overwinter mortality coefficients operate on a percentage scale.
Sex allocation depends on maternal age and mass and is rounded to a planned female count.
OSMIA_MALEMINTARGETPROVISIONMASS is declared but unused; the operational minimum is derived.
Provisioning completion uses a hard-coded 4.3-day carry-over threshold.
The active foraging path uses square windows; the unused legacy radial-mask classes have been removed.
Monthly pollen and nectar thresholds are loaded but not consulted.
The active provisioning path does not deplete landscape pollen.
primary_evidence: Osmia_Female reproductive path and source comment

claim: Default parasitism scales with cell-open time and is not explicitly capped at one.
Pesticide behaviour is conditional rather than wholly inactive.
Population-dynamics output is optional and disabled by default.
primary_evidence: configuration declarations and DoLast output path
